build_image_transforms: build image transforms from an ImageInputCfg with optional augmentation config and normalization settings
create_image_preprocessor: create a composed image preprocessor from an ImageInputCfg with optional augmentation and normalization
review_build_image_transforms: review the build_image_transforms function to understand how it dispatches to registered transform factory types
review_create_image_preprocessor: review the create_image_preprocessor function to understand how it wraps build_image_transforms with composed mode
refactor_transform_factories: refactor the _transform_factories registry to add a new transform type like image_custom or doc_custom
